title: What Makes a Great Psychologist? The Skills & Traits That Matter Most

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了出卖时间赚钱外，还能有其他的收入来源呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr Marianne Trent），自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将你的专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也一直支持两期心理学家完成他们的成长之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖金以及我独家的支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组大师班、大师讲座、个性化指导、一份福南梅森（Fortnum and Mason）礼品以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Have you ever wondered what truly makes a great psychologist?
sentences.zh: 你有没有想过，究竟是什么造就了一位优秀的心理学家？

sentences.en: Is it intelligence, years of training, or something else entirely?
sentences.zh: 是智力、多年的培训，还是完全是别的什么？

sentences.en: Today, I am breaking down the essential skills and traits that every psychologist needs.
sentences.zh: 今天，我将剖析每个心理学家都需要的核心技能和特质。

sentences.en: And I'll even be role-playing some real-life examples.
sentences.zh: 我甚至还会通过角色扮演来演绎一些现实生活中的例子。

sentences.en: Yes, there's an outfit, which will really bring them to life.
sentences.zh: 是的，这里还有一套服装，这真的会让它们生动起来。

sentences.en: So if you're an aspiring psychologist or just fascinated by human behavior, stay tuned.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你是一个有志成为心理学家的人，或者只是对人类行为着迷，请继续关注。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听“有志心理学家播客”。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne, a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Now, the psychologist you see before you has taken many years to get to this point.
sentences.zh: 现在，你面前看到的这位心理学家，花了多年时间才走到今天这一步。

sentences.en: I first went to do my undergraduate degree in psychology in 1999.
sentences.zh: 我最初是在1999年去攻读心理学本科学位的。

sentences.en: I did all sorts of relevant experience, all sorts of different roles.
sentences.zh: 我做过各种相关经验，担任过各种不同的角色。

sentences.en: Did my doctorate in clinical psychology.
sentences.zh: 攻读了临床心理学博士学位。

sentences.en: And I professionally qualified as a clinical psychologist in the year 2011.
sentences.zh: 并在2011年正式获得了临床心理学家的专业资格。

sentences.en: And along the way, I've, of course, picked up traits that I think work pretty well for me in my career as a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，我当然也培养了一些我认为在我的心理学家职业生涯中非常适用的特质。

sentences.en: So I thought it might be really interesting to have a look at what these are.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，来看看这些特质是什么应该会非常有趣。

sentences.en: This is especially helpful if you are considering a career in psychology or if you are already in it.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在考虑从事心理学职业，或者你已经身处其中，这会特别有帮助。

sentences.en: So with no further ado, let's have a little look at the skills and traits that separate good psychologists from great ones.
sentences.zh: 废话不多说，让我们来看看区分优秀心理学家和杰出心理学家的技能和特质。

sentences.en: Whilst, of course, the qualifications and the knowledge are essential, I think it's actually the human skills,
sentences.zh: 当然，尽管资质和知识至关重要，但我认为实际上是人类的技能，

sentences.en: the way we listen, communicate to and respond to others that really define our impact.
sentences.zh: 我们倾听、沟通以及回应他人方的方式，才真正决定了我们的影响力。

sentences.en: And that, of course, are going to be the difference that makes the difference in this kind of battle with AI technologies.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也将是在与人工智能技术的这场较量中产生差异的关键所在。

sentences.en: So the first traits that I think are really important are those of empathy and emotional intelligence.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为非常重要的前两个特质是同理心和情商。

sentences.en: OK, so let's define those terMs.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们来定义这些术语。

sentences.en: Empathy is the ability to understand and share the feelings of another person.
sentences.zh: 同理心是理解和分享他人感受的能力。

sentences.en: Whilst emotional intelligence is the skill of managing our own emotions and reading the emotions of others in order to be able to respond appropriately.
sentences.zh: 而情商则是管理我们自己的情绪并解读他人情绪以做出适当反应的技能。

sentences.en: Let's have a look at our first little roleplay example.
sentences.zh: 让我们来看看我们的第一个小角色扮演例子。

sentences.en: And if you're listening to this as an mp3, you are going to miss out on my costume.
sentences.zh: 如果你是通过mp3收听这个节目，你将会错过我的服装。

sentences.en: So you may want to come and swing by to YouTube where I'm Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能想来YouTube看一看，我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: OK, so let's have a look at our first roleplay example.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们来看看我们的第一个角色扮演例子。

sentences.en: A client has just shared that they're feeling overwhelmed with anxiety and that it feels like no one is understanding them.
sentences.zh: 一位客户刚刚分享说，他们感到被焦虑压得喘不过气来，而且感觉没有人理解他们。

sentences.en: Here is maybe what not to do.
sentences.zh: 以下可能是不要做的事情。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I used to be a bit like that, really.
sentences.zh: 是的，我以前也有点那样，真的。

sentences.en: I think I was probably just, you know, overthinking it, really.
sentences.zh: 我想我可能只是，你知道的，想得太多了，真的。

sentences.en: So have you tried not doing that?
sentences.zh: 所以你试过不要那样做吗？

sentences.en: Just, you know, forget about it, really.
sentences.zh: 只是，你知道的，忘掉它吧，真的。

sentences.en: And you've got to really remember that the people around you might find it a bit boring.
sentences.zh: 你必须要记住，你周围的人可能会觉得有点无聊。

sentences.en: You keep kind of banging on about it.
sentences.zh: 你一直在喋喋不休地谈论它。

sentences.en: So maybe that's why they don't seem that interested.
sentences.zh: 所以也许这就是为什么他们看起来不是那么感兴趣。

sentences.en: Have you tried that?
sentences.zh: 你试过那个吗？

sentences.en: OK, so a better approach, which demonstrates the empathy and the emotional intelligence, which I think are so key, would be something a bit like this.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么一个更好的方法，它体现了我认为至关重要的同理心和情商，会有点像这样。

sentences.en: That sounds really tough.
sentences.zh: 听起来真的很不容易。

sentences.en: It makes complete sense that you'd feel really overwhelmed when you've got so much going on.
sentences.zh: 当你有这么多事情要处理时，你会感到如此不知所措，这完全说得通。

sentences.en: You're not alone in this.
sentences.zh: 在这方面你并不孤单。

sentences.en: And I want to help you to feel more in control.
sentences.zh: 我想帮让你感觉更有掌控力。

sentences.en: So I guess our takeaway from that is that a great psychologist doesn't immediately jump in and fix things.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我们从中得到的启示是，一个伟大的心理学家不会立即介入并解决问题。

sentences.en: We're making space for emotions.
sentences.zh: 我们在为情绪留出空间。

sentences.en: We're making sure that our clients are feeling heard and validated and that they know that it's a safe space,
sentences.zh: 我们要确保我们的客户感到被倾听和被认可，并且他们知道这是一个安全空间，

sentences.en: that they can bring themselves and we can collaborate to find a way forward.
sentences.zh: 他们可以展现真实的自我，我们可以合作寻找前进的道路。

sentences.en: We're not sharing too much about ourselves and we're not making it all about ourselves either.
sentences.zh: 我们不会分享太多关于我们自己的事情，也不会把所有事情都扯到我们自己身上。

sentences.en: We're not dismissing the client because if we do that, you might find that that is the one and only time that you will see them.
sentences.zh: 我们不会敷衍客户，因为如果我们这样做，你可能会发现那是你唯一一次见到他们。

sentences.en: They won't come back.
sentences.zh: 他们不会再来了。

sentences.en: OK, so there's a little bit of food for thought.
sentences.zh: 好的，这里有一些值得思考的东西。

sentences.en: Let's think about the second of our traits, which I think are critical thinking and scientific rigor.
sentences.zh: 让我们来思考第二个特质，我认为它们是批判性思维和科学严谨性。

sentences.en: Let's define our terMs.
sentences.zh: 让我们来定义我们的术语。

sentences.en: So critical thinking means being able to analyse information, evaluate research and apply scientific evidence to practice.
sentences.zh: 因此，批判性思维意味着能够分析信息、评估研究并将科学证据应用于实践。

sentences.en: It's what we think of as a scientist practitioner model.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所认为的科学家-实践者模式。

sentences.en: So an example of this might be that an influencer is sharing a kind of viral TikTok hack for how a 10 second social anxiety cure.
sentences.zh: 所以这的一个例子可能是，一个网红正在分享某种关于10秒治愈社交焦虑的病毒式TikTok秘诀。

sentences.en: I guess a great psychologist doesn't believe the hype.
sentences.zh: 我想一个伟大的心理学家不会盲目相信炒作。

sentences.en: They would look at the evidence.
sentences.zh: 他们会看证据。

sentences.en: They would look for what research shows us.
sentences.zh: 他们会寻找研究向我们展示的内容。

sentences.en: They would look for what clients are telling us about this.
sentences.zh: 他们会关注客户对这有什么看法。

sentences.en: They'd question its validity and assess whether it really works and whether whether it keeps on working, keeps on keeping those problems at bay.
sentences.zh: 他们会质疑其有效性，并评估它是否真的管用，以及它是否能持续管用，能否让这些问题远离。

sentences.en: Because if it just comes back 10 times worse and bites that person in the bum, that is not super helpful.
sentences.zh: 因为如果它以十倍的恶化卷土重来并狠狠地咬了那个人一口，那可真是一点用都没有。

sentences.en: We're not looking to distract from our probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我们不是为了转移我们问题的注意力。

sentences.en: We're looking to make significant changes that help people to be able to cope and to function.
sentences.zh: 我们希望做出重大的改变，帮助人们能够应对和运作。

sentences.en: So I guess our takeaway from that is, yeah, it's really nice to look at new ways of doing things.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我们从中得到的启示是，是的，寻找做事的新方法真的很棒。

sentences.en: And it can be helpful to explore with clients what they might have heard.
sentences.zh: 与客户探讨他们可能听说过的内容也会有所帮助。

sentences.en: But we do need to balance that curiosity with our scientific scepticism and to be able to protect our clients from misleading or harmful practices.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要将这种好奇心与我们的科学怀疑态度平衡起来，并能够保护我们的客户免受误导性或有害做法的侵害。

sentences.en: We've got to be able to be using evidence-based principles that really get results.
sentences.zh: 我们必须能够使用真正能取得成效的循证原则。

sentences.en: Let's take a look at our third traits.
sentences.zh: 让我们来看看我们的第三个特质。

sentences.en: And those are what I would think of as communication and education.
sentences.zh: 这些就是我认为的沟通和教育。

sentences.en: Let's define our terMs.
sentences.zh: 让我们来定义我们的术语。

sentences.en: So, of course, psychologists need to be able to translate complex psychological concepts into everyday language.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，心理学家需要能够将复杂的心理学概念转化为日常语言。

sentences.en: And it's being able to do that to a variety of audiences and picking the right audience for that particular time.
sentences.zh: 并且能够对不同的受众做到这一点，并为那个特定时间挑选正确的受众。

sentences.en: That might mean that it's for clients, for the public, or even for other professionals.
sentences.zh: 这可能意味着对象是客户、公众，甚至是其他专业人士。

sentences.en: So let's have another look at a role play example.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们再看一个角色扮演的例子。

sentences.en: For example, a client might ask, well, what exactly is CBT?
sentences.zh: 例如，客户可能会问，嗯，究竟什么是CBT？

sentences.en: CBT is a type of therapy that looks at the way that our thoughts, our feelings, and our behaviours all act together, which might actually keep us stuck.
sentences.zh: CBT是一种疗法，它着眼于我们的思想、感受和行为如何共同起作用，这实际上可能会让我们陷入困境。

sentences.en: It's kind of a way of helping us to really reprogram, stop doing things on autopilot, to help us think about how our brain and our body responds to challenges that arise for us.
sentences.zh: 这是一种帮助我们真正重塑、停止自动驾驶做事的方式，帮助我们思考我们的大脑和身体如何对出现给我们的挑战做出反应。

sentences.en: So our takeaway from that is that a great psychologist meets people where they are and makes psychology accessible and practical rather than intimidating.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们从中学到的是，一个伟大的心理学家会迎合人们的现状，使心理学变得平易近人且切合实际，而不是令人生畏。

sentences.en: Okay, so this brings us on to our trait four, which is ethical integrity and professionalism.
sentences.zh: 好的，这就把我们带到了我们的第四个特质，即道德诚信和专业精神。

sentences.en: Let's define our terMs.
sentences.zh: 让我们来定义我们的术语。

sentences.en: So psychologists must, of course, always act in the best interest of their clients.
sentences.zh: 因此，心理学家当然必须始终以客户的最佳利益行事。

sentences.en: We've got to follow professional codes of ethics, maintain our boundaries, and be aware of any biases we might have.
sentences.zh: 我们必须遵守职业道德准则，保持我们的界限，并意识到我们可能存在的任何偏见。

sentences.en: An example might be that a client might ask to connect with you on social media or request personal advice outside of sessions.
sentences.zh: 一个例子可能是，客户可能会要求在社交媒体上与你联系，或要求在咨询之外提供个人建议。

sentences.en: A great psychologist kindly but firmly maintains those professional boundaries while still supporting the client's needs too.
sentences.zh: 伟大的心理学家会亲切但坚定地保持这些专业界限，同时也支持客户的需求。

sentences.en: Trait five, flexibility and adaptability.
sentences.zh: 第五个特质，灵活性和适应性。

sentences.en: Let's define our terMs.
sentences.zh: 让我们来定义我们的术语。

sentences.en: Psychologists work with diverse individuals and ever-evolving research.
sentences.zh: 心理学家与形形色色的人以及不断发展的研究合作。

sentences.en: This means that we must continually adapt our approach rather than relying on rigid methods.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们必须不断调整我们的方法，而不是依赖死板的方法。

sentences.en: Let's have another little look at a role play.
sentences.zh: 让我们再来看看另一个角色扮演。

sentences.en: So in this one, a client with social anxiety is struggling to engage with their traditional talking therapy.
sentences.zh: 在这个例子中，一个患有社交焦虑的客户正在努力参与他们的传统谈话疗法。

sentences.en: We need to stick with this approach for at least 12 weeks, otherwise it's not going to make a difference.
sentences.zh: 我们需要坚持这种方法至少12周，否则它不会有任何改变。

sentences.en: Doesn't matter if it's not working right now, we need to stick with it.
sentences.zh: 现在不管它有没有用都没关系，我们需要坚持下去。

sentences.en: Okay, so would you come back after you had been told that?
sentences.zh: 好的，如果有人对你说了那样的话，你还会回来吗？

sentences.en: I don't think I would.
sentences.zh: 我想我不会。

sentences.en: So a better approach would be one that uses kind of adaptive thinking and really honours where the client is right now.
sentences.zh: 所以更好的方法是使用某种适应性思维，并且真正尊重客户目前的处境。

sentences.en: It might look something like this.
sentences.zh: 它可能会是这样的。

sentences.en: Thank you for raising that with me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你向我提出这一点。

sentences.en: I really want to make sure that we can help you to engage in this therapy as much as possible so that you get the benefits.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想确保我们能够帮助你尽可能多地参与这种疗法，以便你获得好处。

sentences.en: It might be the, you know, small tweaks like the where we sit in the room might really help.
sentences.zh: 可能是，你知道的，一些小调整，比如我们在房间里坐的位置，可能会真的有帮助。

sentences.en: So rather than sitting one-on-one opposite each other, we could perhaps think about sitting maybe shoulder-to-shoulder as we talk.
sentences.zh: 所以与其面对面坐着，我们也许可以考虑一边交谈一边并肩而坐。

sentences.en: Or maybe even doing some adult colouring both at the same time as we talk.
sentences.zh: 或者甚至在我们交谈的同时一起做一些成人的填色。

sentences.en: Have you got any other ideas or suggestions for things that you think might be helpful?
sentences.zh: 你还有其他什么想法或建议，觉得可能会有帮助吗？

sentences.en: So I think in this second example, a great psychologist is really knowing that one size does not fit all
sentences.zh: 所以我认为在第二个例子中，一个伟大的心理学家真正知道尺有所短寸有所长

sentences.en: and that we need to be able to adapt our approach to fit the person in front of us and to make sure that the client feels that they've got some buy-in, they've got some power
sentences.zh: 我们需要能够调整我们的方法以适合面前的人，并确保客户觉得他们有一些参与度，他们有一些权力

sentences.en: to be able to really kind of work collaboratively rather than just being done too.
sentences.zh: 能够真正以协作的方式工作，而不是被强加于人。

sentences.en: So those are my five key traits that make a great psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 这些就是造就伟大心理学家的五个核心特质。

sentences.en: We've covered empathy, critical thinking, clear communication, ethical integrity and adaptability.
sentences.zh: 我们涵盖了同理心、批判性思维、清晰的沟通、道德诚信和适应能力。

sentences.en: But what do you think?
sentences.zh: 但你怎么看？

sentences.en: Which one of these traits do you think is most important?
sentences.zh: 你认为这些特质中哪一个最重要？

sentences.en: And are there any other skills that you would add to the list?
sentences.zh: 你还会把什么其他技能加入这个列表吗？

sentences.en: Please do drop a comment below.
sentences.zh: 请在下方留言。

sentences.en: And if you found this content helpful, please don't forget to like and subscribe.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得这个内容有帮助，请不要忘记点赞和订阅。

sentences.en: To learn other great ways of being a brilliant, reflective psychologist, please do check out the Clinical Psychologist Collective book, which gets wonderful reviews.
sentences.zh: 要想了解成为一名出色、反思型心理学家的其他好方法，请查看《临床心理学家合集》这本书，它获得了极好的评价。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world and I'll see you very soon.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分，我们很快再见。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南。

sentences.en: With this podcast, that's your side.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客，这就是你的支柱。

sentences.en: You'll be on your way to the aspiring psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 你将踏上有志心理学家播客的道路，我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了出卖时间赚钱外，还能有其他的收入来源呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One2Money program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将你的专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也一直支持两期心理学家完成他们的成长之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖金以及我独家的支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组大师班、大师讲座、个性化指导、一份福南梅森礼品以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
